title: Book 8 — Urania, Chapter 50
paragraphs: While the Peloponnesian commanders were arguing this, an Athenian came in reporting that the barbarians had arrived in Attica and that the whole land was being laid waste with fire. For the army that had marched through Boeotia with Xerxes, after burning the city of the Thespians (the inhabitants having left and gone to the Peloponnese) and likewise the city of the Plataeans, had now come to Athens and was devastating everything in those parts. Xerxes had burned Thespiai and Plataea because he was told by the Thebans that they were not siding with the Medes.
